records.key: DINOCell, a DINOv2 model that predicts Cellpose-style flows, for live-cell and label-free images. It pins its own torch, numpy and Cellpose, so it runs in an environment of its own.
records.source: DINOCell, a DINOv2 model that predicts Cellpose-style flows, for live-cell and label-free images. It pins its own torch, numpy and Cellpose, so it runs in an environment of its own.
records.translation: DINOCell은 살아 있는 세포 영상과 표지 없는 영상에서 Cellpose 방식의 흐름장을 예측하는 DINOv2 모델입니다. torch, numpy, Cellpose 버전을 별도로 고정하므로 자체 환경에서 실행됩니다.

records.key: Published results (project README, read 2026-09-21; Stillwagon et al. 2026, arXiv:2604.10609): LIVECell test set SEG 0.784, DET 0.926, MMA 0.876, against Cellpose-SAM 0.710 / 0.852 / 0.807. spaCR has not scored this backend on its own data.
records.source: Published results (project README, read 2026-09-21; Stillwagon et al. 2026, arXiv:2604.10609): LIVECell test set SEG 0.784, DET 0.926, MMA 0.876, against Cellpose-SAM 0.710 / 0.852 / 0.807. spaCR has not scored this backend on its own data.

records.key: SAMCell, SAM ViT-B fine-tuned to predict a cell distance map, trained partly on LIVECell. It runs in an environment of its own.
records.source: SAMCell, SAM ViT-B fine-tuned to predict a cell distance map, trained partly on LIVECell. It runs in an environment of its own.
records.translation: SAMCell은 세포 거리 지도를 예측하도록 미세 조정한 SAM ViT-B이며, 훈련 데이터의 일부로 LIVECell을 사용했습니다. 자체 환경에서 실행됩니다.

records.key: SAMCell 1.2.0 is MIT (Copyright 2025 Saahil Sanganeriya). It fine-tunes facebook/sam-vit-base, which is Apache-2.0, and its checkpoints come from the project's GitHub release.
records.source: SAMCell 1.2.0 is MIT (Copyright 2025 Saahil Sanganeriya). It fine-tunes facebook/sam-vit-base, which is Apache-2.0, and its checkpoints come from the project's GitHub release.

records.key: SpotNet finds fluorescent SPOTS -- single molecules, FISH puncta, sequencing-by-synthesis signals -- and returns their coordinates, not masks. Its environment contains TensorFlow and PyTorch. deepcell-spots 0.4.2 needs Python 3.7 to 3.10 available to create that environment; spaCR itself may use a newer Python. The weights need a free DeepCell token. trackpy and deepcell are pinned with it: deepcell-spots pins neither, and pip walked back to trackpy 0.2.3 (2014), whose setup.py cannot build (reported 2026-09-22).
records.source: SpotNet finds fluorescent SPOTS -- single molecules, FISH puncta, sequencing-by-synthesis signals -- and returns their coordinates, not masks. Its environment contains TensorFlow and PyTorch. deepcell-spots 0.4.2 needs Python 3.7 to 3.10 available to create that environment; spaCR itself may use a newer Python. The weights need a free DeepCell token. trackpy and deepcell are pinned with it: deepcell-spots pins neither, and pip walked back to trackpy 0.2.3 (2014), whose setup.py cannot build (reported 2026-09-22).
records.translation: SpotNet은 단일 분자, FISH 점상 신호, 합성 기반 시퀀싱 신호와 같은 형광 점을 찾아 마스크 대신 좌표를 반환합니다. 이 환경에는 TensorFlow와 PyTorch가 포함됩니다. deepcell-spots 0.4.2의 환경을 만들려면 Python 3.7부터 3.10까지의 버전이 사용 가능해야 하며, spaCR 자체는 더 최신 Python을 사용해도 됩니다. 가중치를 받으려면 무료 DeepCell 토큰이 필요합니다. trackpy와 deepcell 버전도 고정합니다. deepcell-spots는 둘 다 고정하지 않아 pip가 trackpy 0.2.3(2014)까지 되돌아갔고, 이 버전의 setup.py 파일은 빌드할 수 없었습니다(2026-09-22 보고).

records.key: DeepCell's models and training data are licensed for non-commercial academic use only (a modified Apache licence), which is NOT the licence spaCR itself carries. Its weights are not public either: they are fetched from users.deepcell.org with a free account's access token, which spaCR reads from DEEPCELL_ACCESS_TOKEN. Read the licence before using SpotNet for anything commercial.
records.source: DeepCell's models and training data are licensed for non-commercial academic use only (a modified Apache licence), which is NOT the licence spaCR itself carries. Its weights are not public either: they are fetched from users.deepcell.org with a free account's access token, which spaCR reads from DEEPCELL_ACCESS_TOKEN. Read the licence before using SpotNet for anything commercial.
records.translation: DeepCell의 모델과 훈련 데이터는 비상업적 학술 용도로만 허가됩니다(수정된 Apache 라이선스). 이는 spaCR 자체의 라이선스와 다릅니다. 가중치도 공개되어 있지 않으며, 무료 계정의 액세스 토큰으로 users.deepcell.org 사이트에서 가져옵니다. spaCR는 DEEPCELL_ACCESS_TOKEN에서 이 토큰을 읽습니다. SpotNet을 상업적 용도로 사용하기 전에 라이선스를 읽으세요.

records.source: Published results: Laubscher et al., 'Accurate single-molecule spot detection for image-based spatial transcriptomics with weakly supervised deep learning', Cell Systems 2024 (doi:10.1016/j.cels.2023.12.008). spaCR has not scored it on its own data.

records.key: What Plaque Assay's Figure mode needs: the YOLO detector that finds plaque images in a figure, RapidOCR, which reads the panel letters and labels around them, and pdfplumber, which renders a PDF's pages and reads its text layer. Installed apart from spaCR so its torch and opencv cannot change spaCR's.
records.source: What Plaque Assay's Figure mode needs: the YOLO detector that finds plaque images in a figure, RapidOCR, which reads the panel letters and labels around them, and pdfplumber, which renders a PDF's pages and reads its text layer. Installed apart from spaCR so its torch and opencv cannot change spaCR's.
records.translation: Plaque Assay의 도판 모드에 필요한 구성 요소입니다. YOLO 검출기는 도판에서 플라크 영상을 찾고, RapidOCR는 주변 패널 문자와 라벨을 읽으며, pdfplumber는 PDF 페이지를 렌더링하고 텍스트 레이어를 읽습니다. spaCR와 별도로 설치되므로 이들의 torch 및 opencv가 spaCR의 해당 버전을 변경하지 않습니다.

records.key: ultralytics is AGPL-3.0, RapidOCR Apache-2.0 and pdfplumber MIT. They are installed into this environment of their own and run in a separate process, so spaCR's own environment and licence are untouched.
records.source: ultralytics is AGPL-3.0, RapidOCR Apache-2.0 and pdfplumber MIT. They are installed into this environment of their own and run in a separate process, so spaCR's own environment and licence are untouched.
records.translation: ultralytics는 AGPL-3.0, RapidOCR는 Apache-2.0, pdfplumber는 MIT 라이선스를 사용합니다. 이들은 자체 환경에 설치되어 별도 프로세스로 실행되므로 spaCR 자체 환경과 라이선스는 변경되지 않습니다.

records.key: Published results: none for this use. The detector's own measurements on published figures are in item 424 (toxoplasma_well_detector_v2).
records.source: Published results: none for this use. The detector's own measurements on published figures are in item 424 (toxoplasma_well_detector_v2).
records.translation: 발표된 결과: 이 용도에 대한 결과는 없습니다. 발표된 도판에 대한 검출기 자체 측정값은 항목 424(toxoplasma_well_detector_v2)에 있습니다.

records.key: It installs into an environment of its own, {environment}, and spaCR's own environment is not changed. Downloads: {packages}. Allow about {size_gb:.0f} GB with CPU PyTorch and several more with CUDA. Installation can take several minutes. The window remains responsive; Cancel stops installation and removes the unfinished environment.
records.source: It installs into an environment of its own, {environment}, and spaCR's own environment is not changed. Downloads: {packages}. The window remains responsive; Cancel stops installation and removes the unfinished environment.
records.translation: 자체 환경인 {environment}에 설치되며 spaCR의 환경은 변경되지 않습니다. 다운로드: {packages}. CPU PyTorch에는 약 {size_gb:.0f} GB가 필요하고 CUDA에는 몇 GB가 더 필요합니다. 설치에는 몇 분이 걸릴 수 있습니다. 창은 계속 응답하며, 취소를 누르면 설치를 중지하고 미완료 환경을 제거합니다.

records.key: Uninstalling {name} deletes its environment, {environment}, and everything downloaded into it. spaCR's own environment is not touched, and you can install it again at any time.
records.source: Uninstalling {name} deletes its environment, {environment}, and everything downloaded into it. spaCR's own environment is not touched, and you can install it again at any time.
records.translation: {name}을(를) 제거하면 해당 환경 {environment} 및 그 안에 다운로드한 모든 항목이 삭제됩니다. spaCR 자체 환경은 변경되지 않으며 언제든 다시 설치할 수 있습니다.

review_kind: AI-assisted source/target and technical review of backend descriptions, licence/provenance notes and installer controls. Bibliographic titles, reported scores, package names, versions and licence identifiers are retained. Two model names remain literal identities. No independent score verification or native-speaker sign-off.
